Most recruitment AI is built by software companies that have never run a volume hiring campaign. RabbiT comes out of Purview's Workforce Solutions and CallOHM voice AI practices: it was built to staff our own delivery centres, service desks and data centre floors, in the languages our markets speak, and it is now offered to clients who hire at scale.

items.a: An AI recruiting platform from CallOHM, a Purview company, that voice-screens applicants in their own language, scores every answer against the role, schedules interviews and follows up on offers, all from one pipeline.

items.q: How does AI voice screening work?
items.a: You drop in a job description and RabbiT parses the must-haves and screening questions. AI agents then call candidates, hold a natural conversation in their preferred language and score each response automatically, 24/7.
30+ languages, so you can reach and fairly evaluate talent regardless of where they are or what they speak.

items.q: Will candidates know they are talking to AI?
items.a: Conversations are designed to be transparent, fair and human-sounding. Every candidate gets the same consistent, unbiased screening.
No. It removes the repetitive work. RabbiT handles high-volume screening, scheduling and follow-up so recruiters spend their time on the people and decisions that matter.

items.q: Can Purview run the campaign for us?
items.a: Yes. Workforce Solutions runs RabbiT as a managed recruitment service, from campaign set-up to compliant in-country contracts through Recruit, Train, Deploy and Contract Payroll.
